name: Tallow Row
concept: A narrow market row with a steep central Dutch gable and a deep timber canopy that shelters each shopfront.
walls: cream render with red brick plinth and dark tile hanging

name: Wheatsheaf Passage
concept: A corner arcade block where a glazed ground-floor colonnade turns the corner and a tall brick parapet caps the upper walls.
walls: buff brick with stone dressings and green ironwork

name: Sterling House
concept: A stone bank block with a rusticated ground-floor colonnade, a pedimented centre, and a dark mansard roof.
walls: honey limestone with grey slate mansard

name: Crescent Tower
concept: A green glass office tower with a stepped setback crown and tall vertical fins that split the facade into simple boxes.
walls: green glass and pale concrete fins

name: Cobalt Ridge
concept: A crisp ribbon-window office with a stepped parapet and a continuous metal spandrel tying the floors together.
walls: pale concrete with dark grey window bands and steel spandrels

name: Ashfield Chambers
concept: A stone office block with tall window bays, deep reveals and a heavy cornice that reads as one solid mass from the street.
walls: honey-coloured limestone with grey granite plinth

name: Cedar Court Flats
concept: A slender residential tower with staggered balconies wrapping two sides and a brick stair bay at the back.
walls: cream brick with deep green window frames and white balconies

name: Bluebell Terrace
concept: A two-storey garden terrace with paired gables, bright front doors and shallow bays projecting from each ground floor.
walls: soft green render with white trim and red tile roof

name: Hollis Semis
concept: A matched pair of semi-detached houses tied together by one tall central chimney, each with a projecting bay under a steep roof gable.
walls: warm red brick with white painted trim

name: Cobble Cottages
concept: A squat pair of pebble-dash cottages with a steep hipped roof pierced by two gabled dormers and small square-pane windows beneath stone lintels.
walls: cream pebbledash over grey flint rubble

name: Fern Court Flats
concept: A low block of two-storey flats held together by a continuous covered colonnade, with a mansard roof and evenly spaced dormers.
walls: pale brick with lime-white render bands

name: Copper Shed
concept: A low workshop block under a sawtooth roof of north-light prisms, with corrugated iron walls and one wide sliding loading door.
walls: corrugated galvanised iron over pale brick base

name: Aggregate Hall
concept: A low works hall whose repeated north-light roof sawtooths run along the whole side, making a crisp grey comb at speed.
walls: pale grey precast concrete with glazed brick plinth

name: Chill Yard Store
concept: A squat insulated store with a pale blue panel body and a crisp grey parapet cap, so it reads as a cool boxy volume in the works district.
walls: pale blue insulated panels with grey metal capping

name: Kiln Row
concept: A narrow brick row with a stepped Dutch gable and cream stone shopfront, lifting its frontage above the old-town street.
walls: dark red brick with cream stone shopfront and window surrounds

name: Spinning Shed
concept: A broad brick mill with a long shallow pitched roof and a tall square stair tower, giving a crisp silhouette against the works sky.
walls: brown brick with pale lintels and slate roof

name: Cinder Lane Station
concept: A three-storey fire station with three tall glazed bays and a square drill tower at one end.
walls: red brick with white glazed bays and pale stone plinth
features: square drill tower with hoist hatch

name: Marsh Road Station
concept: A two-storey station with two tall glazed bays grouped under a shallow barrel roof and a first-floor office band.
walls: cream render with blue-grey window frames

name: Bramley Police Station
concept: A civic police station in pale brick with a recessed entrance porch and a single glazed bay door beside a brick gate pillar.
walls: pale buff brick with white porch and dark grey frames

name: Cobb Corner Shop
concept: A corner shop with a chamfered glazed corner and a first-floor bay window stepping over the junction.
walls: cream stucco with green timber front and grey slate roof

name: Kettle Cafe
concept: A one-storey cafe with a deep front loggia, low parapet, and full-height glazed folding doors that shelter an outdoor terrace.
walls: cream render with sage green joinery

name: Meadow Primary
concept: A two-storey primary school arranged around a shallow courtyard, with a brick base, hanging tile roof, and tall Crittall windows over a covered cloister.
walls: buff brick with red tile hanging and dark Crittall windows

name: Kingsley Market Hall
concept: A long market hall with a north-light sawtooth roof, arched glazed brick bays, and a brick clock gable that reads clearly from the main street.
walls: glazed brick with dark steel frames and stone plinth

name: Wren House
concept: A narrow four-storey office with projecting oriel bays, brick pilasters, and a mansard roof lit by small dormer windows.
walls: red brick with cream stone dressings and dark sash windows

name: Elmwood Clinic
concept: A two-storey clinic with a sawtooth north-light roof running over the waiting hall, giving a jagged profile above a pale brick front.
walls: pale London stock brick with white lintels

name: Ashcombe Library
concept: A two-storey library with a central Dutch gable and a stone bay reading room, lit by a band of tall arched windows under a pale slate roof.
walls: cream Portland stone with grey slate

name: Thistle House
concept: A two-storey home with a steep front gable hung in plain tile and a first-floor jetty projecting over the ground floor.
walls: white render with plain red tile hanging

name: Fen Road Depot
concept: A one-storey depot with a long shallow pitched roof and a run of recessed roller doors, lit by a high band of steel-framed windows.
walls: grey concrete block with red brick plinth
